Render a PMC reference list as a rendered bibliography

Source: R/html-pmc-bib.R
pmc_bibliography_html.Rd

A thin wrapper around bib_html_list(): PMC's reference entries already come with plain-text, DOI and a fallback URL, so – unlike rand_bibliography_html() and vancouver_bibliography_html(), which must first format each entry from parsed fields – there is no formatting step to do first.

Usage

pmc_bibliography_html(refs, cited_at = NULL)

Arguments

refs

A data frame as returned by pmc_ref_entries() (or a subset of its rows).

cited_at

A named list, keys matching (a subset of) refs$key, each value a character vector of anchor ids – typically from bib_cite_link() – to backlink to. Optional.

Value

A character vector of HTML lines (an <ol>).
